Query data with a Shiny user's own account

Source: R/shinyOAuthDB-package.R
shinyOAuthDB-package.Rd

Build Shiny apps that query databases using each visitor's own permissions. Use DBI or dbplyr for SQL, or call fabricQueryR and brickster functions with the user's sign-in.

Details

Supports commercial and cloud-hosted data platforms, as well as self-hosted PostgreSQL, Trino and DuckDB configured for OAuth. Users sign in through a provider the database or query engine trusts; that server enforces their permissions.

Try a self-hosted database locally

With Docker running, use oauth_db_demo() to start PostgreSQL 18, Keycloak and a Shiny app with demo accounts and sample data. The installed package includes the configuration; Docker provides R and native libraries. PostgREST, Trino, StarRocks, DuckDB Quack, libSQL, CrateDB and OpenSearch demos use the same launcher. See the local demo guide for accounts, editing and cleanup.

Start with your source

vignette("getting-started", package = "shinyOAuthDB") links to a guide for each source. Each includes sign-in setup and a complete Shiny app. Read the guides on the documentation website, or install with build_vignettes = TRUE for local vignette() help. For example, use vignette("snowflake", package = "shinyOAuthDB") for Snowflake or vignette("fabric", package = "shinyOAuthDB") for Fabric.

Database queries

Inside server(), pass shinyOAuth's auth$connection to a helper such as oauth_db_azure_sql(). It returns a connection function, con. Get connection <- con() inside a render or reactive expression, then query with DBI or dbplyr.

Platform functions

oauth_db_fabric_api() and oauth_db_databricks_api() call functions from their platforms' R packages with the visitor's credentials. oauth_db_bigquery_api() runs GoogleSQL and returns data frames.

Sign-in settings

The source guides create clients with oauth_db_microsoft_client(), oauth_db_bigquery_client(), oauth_db_databricks_client(), or oauth_db_snowflake_client(). You can also use an existing shinyOAuth client.

See vignette("authorization", package = "shinyOAuthDB") for custom permissions, multiple accounts, and saved query results.
